Hmm. Let me try pressing E while facing up but with the notice board being at (2,7) — maybe the game reads the notice board when I press E and I'm on it, regardless of facing. But all E presses gave "nothing-there".

Let me try a different button combination — maybe there's a hidden "interact with self tile" via pressing E twice quickly.
